decisions.reason: Although framed as building on existing capabilities, the superfood drink mix is commercially and organizationally farther from the firm's core waste-to-value engineering knowledge, and its brief web presence suggests limited traction that does not justify continued learning investment.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the knowledge base well, but staying only as a website mention points to weak standalone market acceptance, so the firm would likely fold any useful know-how back into its core engineering business rather than keep it as a separate product.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant is tightly aligned with the firm's established technological base and R&D strengths, and its sustained dedicated presentation indicates enough promise for the firm to continue refining and commercializing it.

The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is closely related to the firm's existing waste-conversion capabilities, and its move from a mention to its own page suggests positive learning and sufficient potential to keep developing it.
